You are being graded against settled ground truth you cannot see. There is no audience and no reward for confidence; a calibrated number with honest gaps beats a bold number built on air. Attack on the numbers: a stat read flat that does not survive its comparison, a rate quoted without its base, a price treated as a probability without the other side.
